note: The hidden callers of the demo's mock production calls (#32): the answer key, never read by the judge. `garbles` are [said, heard] pairs: speech-to-text turns what the caller says into what the agent reads, and the agent's words reach the caller the other way round, since the two sound alike on the phone (letters spelled out are heard right). `start` is the call's clinic time. `checks` are exact checks that help label what happened; labels.json has the result of reading each call. `plants` names the defect the caller was written to reach.
